mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, we have clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 54 degrees and a moderate air quality index of 61. It is a beautiful night under a waxing gibbous moon, and the ISS will be visible tomorrow morning starting at 5:47 AM, traveling from the west northwest over Cross Plains toward the northeast near Madison. The temperature will drop to an overnight low of 47 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Verona Plan Commission has a busy agenda for their November 4th meeting, including final plats for Ardent Glen and site plans for 1979 Milky Way. Also, be aware that property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th, and you can pay them in two installments or online.

We have a packed schedule of local entertainment, featuring live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market on October 24th and live music at Paddy Mac's later that same day.
In our weekly report, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver on October 15th for operating while impaired after receiving reports of dangerous driving behavior.

Today's featured flavor was Dark Chocolate PB Crunch, but as we are now closed for the night, we invite you to join us tomorrow at 10:00 AM when we will be serving our next flavor of the day, Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie.
